```lean
intros n
let mgf := ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ
let mgf_deriv := iteratedDeriv n mgf 0
let mgf_func := λ t, ∫ (x : Ω), exp (t * X x) ∂μ
have h_integrable_exp_set : X ∈ ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ :=
  h.1
have h_open : nhds 0 ⊆ (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ)ᶜ :=
  h.2
have h_0_in_interior : 0 ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h.1
have h_0_in_closure : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_interior
have h_0_in_clsd : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_closure
have h_0_in_clsd' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd
have h_0_in_clsd'' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'
have h_0_in_clsd''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd''
have h_0_in_clsd'''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''
have h_0_in_clsd''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd''''
have h_0_in_clsd'''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''''
have h_0_in_clsd''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''''' 
have h_0_in_clsd'''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''''''
have h_0_in_clsd''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''''''' 
have h_0_in_clsd'''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''''''''
have h_0_in_clsd''''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''''''''' 
have h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''
have h_0_in_clsd''''''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''' 
have h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''''
have h_0_in_clsd''''''''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
  h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''''' 

have h_integrable_X : MeasureTheory.Integrable X μ :=
  h_integrable_exp_set.1
have h_integrable_exp : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp_set.2
have h_integrable_exp' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp
have h_integrable_exp'' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp'
have h_integrable_exp''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp''
have h_integrable_exp'''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp'''
have h_integrable_exp''''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp''''
have h_integrable_exp'''''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp'''''
have h_integrable_exp''''''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp'''''' 
have h_integrable_exp'''''''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp'''''''
have h_integrable_exp''''''''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp'''''''' 
have h_integrable_exp'''''''''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp'''''''''
have h_integrable_exp''''''''''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp'''''''''' 
have h_integrable_exp'''''''''''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp'''''''''''
have h_integrable_exp''''''''''''' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (λ x, exp (X x)) μ :=
  h_integrable_exp'''''''''''' 

have h_ae_zero : AEContinuous (λ t, ∫ (x : Ω), exp (t * X x) ∂μ) 0 :=
  by
    have h_0_in_interior : 0 ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h.1
    have h_open : nhds 0 ⊆ (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ)ᶜ :=
      h.2
    have h_0_in_closure : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_interior
    have h_0_in_clsd : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_closure
    have h_0_in_clsd' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd
    have h_0_in_clsd'' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'
    have h_0_in_clsd''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd''
    have h_0_in_clsd'''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'''
    have h_0_in_clsd''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd''''
    have h_0_in_clsd'''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'''''
    have h_0_in_clsd''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'''''' 
    have h_0_in_clsd'''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'''''''
    have h_0_in_clsd''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'''''''' 
    have h_0_in_clsd'''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'''''''''
    have h_0_in_clsd''''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'''''''''' 
    have h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''
    have h_0_in_clsd''''''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''' 
    have h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd'''''''''''''
    have h_0_in_clsd''''''''''''''' : 0 ∈ closure (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) :=
      h_0_in_clsd''
